questions.question: What is the primary function of Virtual Customer Assistance (VCA) in call centers?

options.A: To replace all human agents permanently
options.B: To predict and respond to inquiries before human interaction is needed
options.C: To handle only technical support tickets

questions.explanation:
VCA uses voice recognition and simulated dialogue to predict and respond to customer inquiries, escalating complex issues to humans. (Source Page: [4])
